title: Iran Will Not Be Bullied, President Masoud Pezeshkian Says in U.N. Speech
summary: President Masoud Pezeshkian said his country would not give up its civilian nuclear program, but left the door opened for diplomacy with the United States.
body_markdown: President Masoud Pezeshkian said his country would not give up its civilian nuclear program, but left the door opened for diplomacy with the United States.
